title: AI Safety & Alignment — Test Outside the Friendly Distribution
key_insight: Capability and safety evaluations should include distribution shift, adversarial pressure, long-horizon tasks, and attempts to bypass oversight.
body:
## Test Outside the Friendly Distribution

A system behaves safely on familiar prompts but fails after gaining a new tool or entering a competitive setting. The deployment changed the incentives.

Capability and safety evaluations should include distribution shift, adversarial pressure, long-horizon tasks, and attempts to bypass oversight.

Increase autonomy and access gradually. Gate each expansion on evidence, and retain a reliable way to stop or limit the system.
common_mistakes: A high benchmark score proves complete alignment.
One safety prompt removes every misuse path.
Human approval is meaningful even when the reviewer cannot assess the work.
mini_exercise: Draw “Test Outside the Friendly Distribution” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: More capable and autonomous systems can amplify specification mistakes, misuse, and unexpected behavior.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Test Outside the Friendly Distribution,” explain AI Safety & Alignment without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
